method: stratified 5-fold CV (same folds as results_cv.json), 20 epochs, torch.manual_seed(SEED + fold) before each model (seeded, unlike results_cv.json). default = untrimmed first 4 s zero-padded (as results_cv.json); vad = codec round-trip -> Silero speech_only -> tile-repeat to >= 4 s -> first 4 s, for train and score. false_alarms / misses counted at threshold 0.5.

candidate_model.train: all 38 clips x 5 conditions, VAD+tile, 20 epochs, seed 0
candidate_model.note: expects VAD-trimmed + tiled input (vad.speech_only then tile), not the raw clip

sanity_mid_speech.method: data/real clips with the first 2 s removed (recording starts mid-speech); model.pth scored on first 4 s zero-padded as the old app did, model_pilot_vad.pth on speech_only -> tile -> first 4 s; threshold 0.5. IN-SAMPLE: both models were trained on these clips.
